question: Why did the optimization of the hydroquinone-catechol vacuum distillation raise the distillate-to-feed ratio above the industrial baseline?
expect: premise false: D/F was REDUCED from 0.121 to 0.092 (abstract)
rendered: The optimization of the hydroquinone-catechol vacuum distillation raised the distillate-to-feed ratio above the industrial baseline to improve the separation efficiency. The initial baseline distillate-to-feed ratio of 0.121 was reduced to 0.092, which allowed for more effective enrichment of catechol in the distillate while maintaining high-purity hydroquinone in the bottoms.
